SELECT id, name, points, rank_no, avatar_url FROM ( SELECT t.id AS id, t.sporter AS name, t.points AS points, t.avatar_url AS avatar_url, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.points DESC, t.sporter ASC) AS rank_no FROM BC_SPORTS_BCP_SPORT_POINTS t WHERE t.deleted = 0 )
name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ESCAPE '\'
rank_no <= #{limit}
ORDER BY rank_no
FETCH FIRST 500 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "participants", NVL(SUM(points), 0) AS "totalPoints" FROM BC_SPORTS_BCP_SPORT_POINTS WHERE deleted = 0
